device: Snapdragon X2 Elite X2E84100 / SC8480XP / HTP V81
python: Global 3.14.7 x64, no venv; inference process native ARM64
recommended: artifacts/optimized (conservative FP16 preset), subject to the recorded absolute ONNX limitations and listening evaluation

experiments.bucketing: 64/96/128 latent frames; six initial cases had bit-exact audio versus the 128-frame baseline
experiments.layout: Exact FP32 graph reformulation: keep ConvNeXt pointwise MLP in BLC layout; FP16 rounding changes
experiments.tanh_gelu: Rejected as a full-pipeline speed improvement; 297.6 ms versus 296.0 ms at 96 frames in the screen
experiments.full_a16w8: Rejected: vocoder held-out relative L2 5.215; calibration-case device error 6.419; eager PTQ calibration-sample error 0.124
experiments.affine_a16w8: Rejected: 37 delegate partitions with CPU compute remaining; eager PTQ sample error 0.109
experiments.full_flow_layout: Experimental: additional absolute numerical failures on short English and Portuguese at seed 42, Korean spectral error at seed 43

final-8steps.limitations: Small held-out corpus, one seed; numerical checks do not establish perceptual quality or WER
